description: This file defines the OrderAccount class, a JPA entity representing an order account in the system, including fields for dates, associated order, billing day, and related products.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: A JPA entity representing an order account linked to an order and its associated products, with start/end dates and billing day information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the order account.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the order account.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates an Order with this Account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date of the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date of the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Returns the billing day of the order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountBillDay
methods.description: Sets the billing day of the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the set of products associated with this order account.

methods.name: setOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Associates a set of products with this order account.
